responsibility: This utility generates derived macro views of the combined_fn namespace from builtins.def and internal-fn.def. It groups related built-in and internal math or integer functions by suffix families, validates that internal functions have the expected built-in variants, and emits either CASE_CFN_* switch macros for compiler code or define_operator_list forms for match.pd so that folding and pattern-matching code can treat builtin-function families as a single logical operator.
